title: Receptionist
description:
**About the role:** We are looking for a pleasant Front Desk Representative to undertake all patient and office management duties. You will be the “face” of the company for all visitors and will be responsible for the first impression we make. The ideal candidate will have a friendly and easy going personality while also being very perceptive and disciplined.

You should be able to deal with complaints and give accurate information. A customer\-oriented approach is essential. The goal is to make guests and visitors feel comfortable and valued while on our premises.

**Location**: East of Kailash

**Responsibilities**:

● Act as the first point of contact for patients and customers

● Appointment Booking over call and for walk\-in patients, including basic query resolutions from potential patients

● Managing patient flow for ongoing patient treatments such as coordinating time slots with doctor and patients, answering basic patient queries etc

● Manage Billing \+ Payments; Regular Reporting of daily business with HQ Team

● Responsible for the upkeep and smooth functioning of the centre

● Maintain inventory including pharmaceuticals, treatment essentials and other goods sold ● Maintain essential resources for the smooth functioning of the centre

● Coordinating with local vendors to ensure smooth functioning of the centre

● Coordinating with HQ to replenish resources and inventory on a monthly basis

● Staff Management such as ensuring regular attendance

**Requirements**:

● Intermediate computer skills are a must

● Strong communication and people skills

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable with the salary range of 15k\-18k?
* Are you comfortable with East of Kailash location?

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Consultant IVF Specialist
description:
**Consultant IVF Specialist**

Join RISAA IVF – a leading network of 10\+ IVF clinics across India, Nepal \& Afghanistan, headquartered in New Delhi. Led by renowned IVF specialist Dr. Rita Bakshi, RISAA IVF is committed to delivering advanced fertility care through state\-of\-the\-art IVF laboratories, world\-class technology, and compassionate patient support.

Location: Green Park, New Delhi (with travel to nearby centres as required)  
**Position:** Consultant IVF Specialist  
**Experience:** Experienced 2\-3 Years

Job Type: Full\-Time  
Salary: Best in the Industry

**Qualification:**  
MD/MS/DNB in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology  
FNB / DNB / Fellowship / Diploma in Reproductive Medicine preferred  
Fellowship in ART from a reputed institute will be an added advantage

**Key Responsibilities:**  
Manage and coordinate IVF, IUI, and fertility treatment cycles  
Perform OPU (Oocyte Pick\-Up), Embryo Transfer (ET), and related fertility procedures  
End\-to\-end cycle monitoring and clinical decision\-making as per protocols  
Ensure all investigations, procedures, and documentation are completed accurately  
Provide patient counseling, education, and treatment guidance  
Communicate laboratory results and treatment plans effectively to patients  
Participate in CMEs, patient awareness camps, RTMs, and outreach programs  
Support teaching, training, and academic activities  
Manage peripheral centres and travel to nearby locations when required  
Monitor and maintain high standards of patient care and treatment outcomes

**Key Skills:**  
IVF \& Reproductive Medicine Expertise  
OPU, ET \& Fertility Procedure Management Patient Counseling \& Communication Skills  
Clinical Decision\-Making \& Cycle Monitoring  
Team Collaboration \& Teaching Ability  
Strong Documentation \& Patient Management Skills

**Walk\-In Interview Location**:  
H\-6, 2nd Floor, Green Park Main Market,  
Above Toothsi Clinic, New Delhi – 110016

Share your CV at: hr@risaaivf.com

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Showroom Manager
description:
The **Senior Showroom Manager** leads daily operations and drives luxury sales at our high\-end lighting showroom. You will manage the showroom team, build relationships with interior designers and architects, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Must Have :

1\. Vehicle Two wheelers

2\. Computer Knowledge

3\. 5\-6 Yrs Experience in Showroom management.

4\. Communication Skills

5\. Pleasing Personality.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Revenue

* Meet and exceed monthly and yearly sales goals.
* Guide the team to upsell and cross\-sell luxury lighting collections.
* Close high\-value deals with walk\-in clients, homeowners, and trade professionals.

Team Leadership

* Hire, train, and mentor sales consultants and support staff.
* Set performance targets and conduct regular reviews.
* Schedule staff to ensure proper coverage during peak hours.

Client and Trade Relations

* Build strong networks with interior designers, architects, and contractors.
* Host trade events, product launches, and designer networking nights.
* Handle VIP client requests and resolve any customer issues quickly.

Showroom Operations

* Maintain high visual standards and pristine product displays.
* Ensure all lighting fixtures, smart systems, and displays work properly.
* Manage inventory, stock levels, and sample orders.
* Oversee point\-of\-sale (POS) systems, cash handling, and daily reports.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person
